## Installation

```{r install, eval = FALSE}
install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("IMPALA-Consortium/gsm.ctas")
```

## Load

```{r load, message = FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(dplyr))
library(workr)
library(gsm.mapping)
library(gsm.kri)
library(gsm.ctas)
```

## Raw data

`gsm.ctas` ships SDTM domains (`dm`, `lb`, `vs`, `eg`, `rs`) and a synthetic
ctasapp `queries` frame.

```{r raw}
lRaw <- list(
  Raw_DM = gsm.ctas::dm,
  Raw_LB = gsm.ctas::lb,
  Raw_VS = gsm.ctas::vs,
  Raw_EG = gsm.ctas::eg,
  Raw_RS = gsm.ctas::rs,
  Raw_Queries = gsm.ctas::queries
)

str(lRaw, max.level = 1)
```

## Mapping

```{r mapping}
lMappingWorkflows <- workr::MakeWorkflowList(
  strNames = NULL,
  strPath = system.file("workflow/1_mappings", package = "gsm.ctas"),
  strPackage = NULL
)

lIngest <- gsm.mapping::Ingest(lRaw, gsm.mapping::CombineSpecs(lMappingWorkflows))

lMapped <- suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(
  workr::RunWorkflows(lWorkflows = lMappingWorkflows, lData = lIngest)
))

names(lMapped)
```

## `Standardize_Domain()`

Rename an SDTM domain into the CTAS long vocabulary. Default output is
numeric-ready (`parameter_category_3 = "numeric"`).

```{r standardize_domain}
dfVS <- Standardize_Domain(
  dfDomain = lMapped$Mapped_VS,
  dfSubjects = lMapped$Mapped_Subjects,
  strTestCDCol = "VSTESTCD",
  strTestCol = "VSTEST",
  strValueCol = "VSSTRESN",
  strCategory = "Vital Signs"
)

dfVS
```

## `Transform_Range()`

Rescale each result into its reference range (`(x - low) / (high - low)`).

```{r transform_range}
dfLBraw <- Standardize_Domain(
  dfDomain = lMapped$Mapped_LB,
  dfSubjects = lMapped$Mapped_Subjects,
  strTestCDCol = "LBTESTCD",
  strTestCol = "LBTEST",
  strValueCol = "LBSTRESN",
  strLowCol = "LBSTNRLO",
  strHighCol = "LBSTNRHI",
  strCategory = "Labs"
)

dfRange <- Transform_Range(dfLBraw)

dfRange
```

## `Transform_Missing()`

Recode each observation as a 0/1 indicator of missingness for
missingness-over-time monitoring.

```{r transform_missing}
dfMissing <- Transform_Missing(dfLBraw)

dfMissing
```

## `Transform_OneHot()`

Expand a categorical variable into one binary CTAS timeseries per level.

```{r transform_onehot}
dfRSraw <- Standardize_Domain(
  dfDomain = gsm.ctas::rs %>% filter(RSTESTCD == "OVRLRESP"),
  dfSubjects = lMapped$Mapped_Subjects,
  strTestCDCol = "RSTESTCD",
  strTestCol = "RSTEST",
  strValueCol = "RSSTRESC",
  strCategory = "Disease Response"
)

dfOneHot <- Transform_OneHot(dfRSraw)

unique(dfOneHot$parameter_id)
dfOneHot
```

## `Standardize_Queries()`

Translate the ctasapp query upload schema into the CTAS long vocabulary and
fan raw field ids out onto every transformed CTAS parameter id.

```{r standardize_queries}
dfInputSample <- Transform_Range(dfLBraw)

dfQ <- Standardize_Queries(
  dfQueries = lMapped$Mapped_Queries,
  dfSubjects = lMapped$Mapped_Subjects,
  dfInput = dfInputSample
)

dfQ
```

## `Analyze_CTAS()`

Score one long-format CTAS frame. Returns one row per site × timeseries ×
feature.

```{r analyze_ctas}
dfScored <- suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(
  Analyze_CTAS(dfVS)
))

dfScored
```

Multi-study is honoured automatically when `Mapped_Subjects` carries several
`studyid` values; results are stacked with a `study` column.

## Metrics workflow

```{r metrics}
lMetricWorkflows <- workr::MakeWorkflowList(
  strNames = NULL,
  strPath = system.file("workflow/2_metrics", package = "gsm.ctas"),
  strPackage = NULL
)

lAnalysis <- suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(
  workr::RunWorkflows(lWorkflows = lMetricWorkflows, lData = lMapped)
))

names(lAnalysis)
```

## `BindResults_CTAS()`

Concatenate one named frame (`"results"`, `"input"`, `"untransformed"`)
across every metric workflow output.

```{r bind_results_ctas}
dfResultsLong <- BindResults_CTAS(lAnalysis, "results")

dfResultsLong
```

## `Summarize_CTAS()` + `Flag_CTAS()`

Aggregate to the gsm `dfResults` contract, then flag with left-closed
intervals on `-log10(p)`.

```{r summarize}
dfSummary <- Summarize_CTAS(
  dfResults = dfResultsLong,
  dfSubjects = lMapped$Mapped_Subjects
)

dfSummary

dfFlagged <- Flag_CTAS(dfSummary)

dfFlagged

length(unique(dfFlagged$MetricID))
```

## `MakeMetric_CTAS()`

Emit the family-granular audit table (`ctas_<pc3>_<pc2>`), one row per
field × metric family, with every CTAS parameter column from the metric
YAMLs.

```{r make_metric_ctas}
dfInputBound <- BindResults_CTAS(lAnalysis, "input")

dfMetricsAudit <- MakeMetric_CTAS(
  dfResults = dfResultsLong,
  lMetricWorkflows = lMetricWorkflows,
  dfInput = dfInputBound
)

dfMetricsAudit
```

## Full workflow

The four packaged workflow layers -- mapping, metrics, reporting, modules
-- chain end-to-end.

```{r workflow}
lRaw <- list(
  Raw_DM = gsm.ctas::dm,
  Raw_LB = gsm.ctas::lb,
  Raw_VS = gsm.ctas::vs,
  Raw_EG = gsm.ctas::eg,
  Raw_RS = gsm.ctas::rs,
  Raw_Queries = gsm.ctas::queries
)

lMappingWorkflows <- workr::MakeWorkflowList(
  strPath = system.file("workflow/1_mappings", package = "gsm.ctas")
)
lMetricWorkflows <- workr::MakeWorkflowList(
  strPath = system.file("workflow/2_metrics", package = "gsm.ctas")
)
lReportingWorkflows <- workr::MakeWorkflowList(
  strPath = system.file("workflow/3_reporting", package = "gsm.ctas")
)
lModuleWorkflows <- workr::MakeWorkflowList(
  strPath = system.file("workflow/4_modules", package = "gsm.ctas")
)

lMapped <- suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(workr::RunWorkflows(
  lWorkflows = lMappingWorkflows,
  lData = gsm.mapping::Ingest(lRaw, gsm.mapping::CombineSpecs(lMappingWorkflows))
)))

lAnalysis <- suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(workr::RunWorkflows(
  lWorkflows = lMetricWorkflows,
  lData = lMapped
)))

lReporting <- suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(workr::RunWorkflows(
  lWorkflows = lReportingWorkflows,
  lData = c(lMapped, list(
    lAnalyzed = lAnalysis,
    lMetricWorkflows = lMetricWorkflows
  ))
)))

workr::RunWorkflows(
  lWorkflows = lModuleWorkflows,
  lData = lReporting
)
```

## ctasapp export

[ctasapp](https://github.com/IMPALA-Consortium/ctasapp) only consumes the
`results`, `input`, `untransformed` and `queries` frames -- the
`3_reporting` outputs `Reporting_Results` and `Reporting_Queries`. The
`Summary`, `Metrics`, `Groups` frames and the `4_modules` html render are
not needed. Filter the reporting layer with `strNames` to skip the
site-report-only workflows:

```{r ctasapp_workflow, eval = FALSE}
lRaw <- list(
  Raw_DM = gsm.ctas::dm,
  Raw_LB = gsm.ctas::lb,
  Raw_VS = gsm.ctas::vs,
  Raw_EG = gsm.ctas::eg,
  Raw_RS = gsm.ctas::rs,
  Raw_Queries = gsm.ctas::queries
)

lMappingWorkflows <- workr::MakeWorkflowList(
  strPath = system.file("workflow/1_mappings", package = "gsm.ctas")
)
lMetricWorkflows <- workr::MakeWorkflowList(
  strPath = system.file("workflow/2_metrics", package = "gsm.ctas")
)
lReportingWorkflows <- workr::MakeWorkflowList(
  strNames = c("Results", "Queries"),
  strPath = system.file("workflow/3_reporting", package = "gsm.ctas")
)

lMapped <- workr::RunWorkflows(
  lWorkflows = lMappingWorkflows,
  lData = gsm.mapping::Ingest(lRaw, gsm.mapping::CombineSpecs(lMappingWorkflows))
)

lAnalysis <- workr::RunWorkflows(
  lWorkflows = lMetricWorkflows,
  lData = lMapped
)

lReporting <- workr::RunWorkflows(
  lWorkflows = lReportingWorkflows,
  lData = c(lMapped, list(
    lAnalyzed = lAnalysis,
    lMetricWorkflows = lMetricWorkflows
  ))
)

Write_ctasapp(lReporting, strDir = "pub", strFormat = "parquet")
```

Point ctasapp at the parquet folder by editing its `embedded:` block:

```{r ctasapp, eval = FALSE}
remotes::install_github("IMPALA-Consortium/ctasapp")
file.copy(system.file("ctasapp.yml", package = "ctasapp"), "ctasapp.yml")
# embedded:
#   results: pub/results.parquet
#   input: pub/input.parquet
#   untransformed: pub/untransformed.parquet
ctasapp::run_ctas_app()
```
